Author: Valenth Siveria
Name: BlackJack Buttler
Punchline: Good evening. I'm your BlackJack Buttler - quietly tracking the table and offering the right hint at the right time.
Changelog:
v1.8.4.5

FIXED:
- No more 0 cards in Auto Mode when Player Roll Mode is enabled: the game now waits for the active player's valid 13-sided roll
- Only the player whose turn is active can satisfy the pending self-roll

NEW:
- Player Roll Mode can now be configured individually per player from the player table
- All players default to self-roll; disabled players are rolled automatically by the dealer system
- Per-player choices are saved persistently
